subject: MAP: evaluation-to-reserve cadence and GPU tranche sizing for NimbleAI
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@nimble.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP request & lead times — NimbleAI evaluation

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and token-cost breakdowns. Procurement asked me to kick off a Mutual Action Plan so we can align evaluation milestones with a capacity reservation commit. A few asks: 

- Can you confirm typical lead times for Dedicated reservations vs Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments?
- We've sized an initial staging pool at ~8 H100 nodes and a production pool at ~24 H100 nodes — do those numbers look like the right starting point?
- We want a realistic close timeline so our SRE and procurement leads can plan internal approvals.

Can you share a MAP draft and a simple capacity/cost estimate that we can attach to our procurement packet? We hope to have procurement sign-off within three weeks if timelines line up.

Attachments: none (we'll attach the RFP if useful)

Best,
Sara Chen
Head of Cloud Engineering, NimbleAI
procurement@nimble.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@nimble.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & lead times — NimbleAI evaluation

Sara —

Appreciate the clear ask. I put together a short MAP + capacity sketch below and attached a spreadsheet with dates and an initial sizing/cost tab (NimbleAI_MAP_v0.2.xlsx). High level: we can absolutely support a staged evaluation that maps to a reservation commit with staggered tranches. Quick summary first, then the MAP table.

Quick answers:
- Dedicated (hosted reserved capacity): typical procurement-to-activation lead time is ~6–8 weeks after signed commitment (shorter if we prioritize a tranche).
- Private (VPC-managed or on-prem install): 10–14 weeks depending on customer's network approvals and on-prem procurement lead times.
- Sizing check: 8 H100s for staging / 24 H100s production is reasonable as a starting point for high-throughput RLHF/adaptive workloads. We recommend a 2x KV-cache / batching headroom safety factor for headroom during eval.

Proposed MAP & close cadence (examples — dates are relative to signature):
- Week 0: Sign MAP (DocuSign) & initial 30% tranche commit — trigger Dedicated tranche provisioning (target activation W6).
- Weeks 1–4: Evaluation sprints (test corpus + perf/quality gates).
- Week 5: Canary run on dedicated tranche (staging).
- Week 6: Dedicated tranche live; begin production-roll tests.
- Weeks 7–10: Optional second tranche (scale to 24 H100s) activation.
- Weeks 11–14: If Private on-prem chosen, network-handoff & on-site install (customer infra permitting).

Operational notes:
- We support staggered tranches to reduce lead-time risk. If NimbleAI can accept the first tranche (8 H100s) ahead of full commit, we can cut the effective activation window by ~2 weeks.
- Quantization/optimizer choices: if you can accept a mixed-precision INT8/FP16 profile in production, we can reduce required GPU count for equivalent throughput — I flagged this as an action item below.

Next steps / asks for NimbleAI:
1) Confirm whether procurement can sign a 30% tranche to start (we'll map invoice & PO accordingly).
2) Confirm SRE availability for our network checklist during Weeks 2–4 (for Private flows).
3) Provide any compliance constraints (SOC2 data residency, approved KMS provider).

I've attached: NimbleAI_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP milestones + timelines) and capacity_estimate.csv (node-level cost/sizing). I also dropped a draft DocuSign link if you're ready to move forward.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-nimbleai-po
Drive MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-NimbleAI-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/98765

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow to walk through the MAP and gating criteria.

– Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP request & lead times — NimbleAI evaluation

Markus — quick thoughts inline and a few trade-offs to propose.

> Proposed MAP & close cadence (examples — dates are relative to signature):
> - Week 0: Sign MAP (DocuSign) & initial 30% tranche commit — trigger Dedicated tranche provisioning (target activation W6).
> - Weeks 1–4: Evaluation sprints (test corpus + perf/quality gates).

Looks good. A couple of internal points to consider before we finalize the MAP: 

1) Staggered tranches: can we offer an accelerated “pre-warm” option where NimbleAI gets short-lived spot-backed instances for the first 2 weeks to reduce early friction? That would avoid pushing the full procurement activation for staging and buy time for procurement. If so, we should add an explicit action: "Confirm pre-warm acceptance" in Week 0.

2) Quantization / throughput trade: if NimbleAI is open to an INT8 profile for evaluation, we can advertise a smaller production node target (e.g., 18 H100s instead of 24) — risk is slight quality delta on edge prompts. We should make this a clear decision node in the MAP (Decision: adopt INT8 for X workloads?).

3) Private lead time: 10–14 weeks is fine but network approvals are the gating path. Suggest we add an "Infra pre-check" milestone the moment we sign the MAP (Week 0–1) so that we start security & network paperwork in parallel with the dedicated provisioning.

If you want, I can draft the updated MAP with these two decision nodes and a parallel path diagram. Also, confirm whether NimbleAI's procurement needs a vendor W-9 (US) or certificate — I can route to legal.

— Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@nimble.ai>

Cc: procurement@nimble.ai
Date: 2026-05-14T17:03:00-07:00

Markus / Karthik —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. We reviewed internally and procurement is willing to do the 30% tranche to start. A few confirmations: 

- NimbleAI accepts staggered tranches and would like the pre-warm option you mentioned — that will help product teams start smoke tests while procurement finishes the remainder of approvals.
- We'll accept an INT8/FP16 hybrid evaluation profile for the perf gates (ops team will validate quality on a small prompt set).
- Procurement attached the initial PO (PurchaseOrder_NimbleAI.pdf) and will route DocuSign this week.

Can you add the "Infra pre-check" milestone and pre-warm step to the MAP and resend the spreadsheet? We'll target signing the first tranche by COB Friday (2026-05-21) assuming DocuSign completes.

Appreciate the quick alignment — cc'ing procurement for visibility.

Best,
Sara Chen
Head of Cloud Engineering, NimbleAI
